articles.title: Vacina contra pneumonia está disponível para idosos 85+ em Fortaleza | G1
articles.standfirst: Imunizante está disponível nos 134 postos de saúde da cidade. Para receber a dose, idosos devem apresentar documento oficial com foto para comprovar idade.
articles.summary: Imunizante está disponível nos 134 postos de saúde da cidade. Para receber a dose, idosos devem apresentar documento oficial com foto para comprovar idade.
articles.body:
Prefeitura de Fortaleza oferta vacina Pneumo 20 a idosos com 85 anos ou mais. — Foto: Divulgação/Prefeitura de Fortaleza

A Prefeitura de Fortaleza informou que a vacina Pneumo 20 está disponível em todos os 134 postos de saúde da capital para pessoas a partir de 85 anos . O imunizante protege contra 20 tipos da bactéria Streptococcus pneumoniae, causadora de doenças como pneumonia e meningite.

A indicação da Pneumo 20 para os idosos a partir de 85 anos depende do histórico de vacinação de cada indivíduo, conforme o seguinte esquema:

Pessoas com nenhuma dose prévia - dose única de Pneumo 20;

Pessoas com apenas uma dose de Pneumo-13 ou Pneumo-15 - Dose única de Pneumo 20 com intervalo mínimo de dois meses para a primeira dose;

Pessoas com apenas uma dose de Pneumo 23 - Dose única de Pneumo 20 com intervalo mínimo de um ano para a primeira dose.

Para receber a vacina, não é preciso apresentar prescrição médica . Basta levar documento oficial com foto para comprovar a idade.

Segundo a Prefeitura, a ampliação do público-alvo da vacina segue as diretrizes do Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), do Ministério da Saúde (MS). A iniciativa busca prevenir essas doenças e reduzir o risco de complicações, especialmente entre as pessoas idosas.

Em junho de 2026, a Pneumo 20 começou a substituir gradualmente a Pneumo 10 no calendário de vacinação infantil, inicialmente para as doses de rotina aplicadas aos 2 e 4 meses de vida e para a dose de reforço aos 12 meses.

Durante o período de transição, as unidades de saúde utilizam os dois imunizantes, conforme o esquema vacinal de cada criança, priorizando a introdução da vacina que oferece proteção contra um número maior de tipos de pneumococo.

Além das crianças e dos idosos a partir de 85 anos, a Pneumo 20 também é indicada para pessoas com condições clínicas especiais , como HIV/Aids, câncer e histórico de transplante de órgãos sólidos ou de medula óssea, entre outras.

articles.title: Mais de 160 pinguins aparecem mortos em um único dia em cidade de SC | G1
articles.standfirst: Número supera em 33% a média histórica mensal para toda a região Norte do estado. Registro ocorreu na Praia Grande e no Ervino, em São Francisco do Sul.
articles.summary: O registro em São Francisco do Sul supera a média mensal em 33% e equipes investigam se as mortes de pinguins em SC têm relação com as recentes frentes frias.
articles.body:
Mais de 160 pinguins-de-magalhães foram encontrados mortos em praias de São Francisco do Sul , no Norte de Santa Catarina , só na segunda-feira (12).

O volume registrado em um único dia supera em 33% a média histórica mensal para toda a região Norte do estado, que é de cerca de 120 pinguins durante todo o mês de outubro.

Segundo o Projeto de Monitoramento de Praias da Bacia de Santos (PMP-BS), executado na região pela Universidade da Região de Joinville ( Univille ), os registros ocorreram nos trechos da Praia Grande e do Ervino, que somam aproximadamente 26 quilômetros de faixa de areia.

No mesmo dia, a equipe também resgatou outros três pinguins vivos e debilitados nas praias de Itaguaçu, Forte e Ervino, após receber acionamentos de moradores.

Pinguins foram encontrados em praias de São Francisco do Sul — Foto: PMP-BS/Univille

Número é 33% maior do que a média esperada para o mês na região

De acordo com André Barreto, coordenador do PMP-BS, a quantidade de animais encontrados chama a atenção porque outubro costuma registrar uma redução nos encalhes de pinguins na região.

“Tradicionalmente, o pico de ocorrências é em agosto e, depois disso, a quantidade vai reduzindo”, explicou.

Em 2026, o maior número de registros ocorreu em julho, em volume acima do habitual. Após uma queda expressiva em agosto e setembro, a expectativa era de que outubro apresentasse ainda menos ocorrências.

Nas últimas duas semanas, entretanto, houve um aumento de registros em todos os trechos monitorados , principalmente nas áreas mais ao Norte de Santa Catarina e no Paraná.

Frentes frias podem ter relação com aumento de encalhes

Segundo Barreto, a equipe acompanha os registros para investigar se o aumento tem relação com as frentes frias intensas das últimas semanas ou com outros fatores.

As frentes frias podem aproximar os pinguins da costa e, consequentemente, aumentar os encalhes nas praias.

Até o momento, não há uma causa confirmada para a concentração de animais encontrados mortos em São Francisco do Sul.

Por que os pinguins aparecem nas praias de SC?

Os pinguins-de-magalhães ( Spheniscus magellanicus ) são aves migratórias.

Durante o inverno, especialmente entre junho e setembro, eles deixam colônias na Argentina, nas Ilhas Malvinas e no Chile em busca de alimento e podem chegar às águas das regiões Sul e Sudeste do Brasil.

Segundo a equipe técnica do PMP-BS/Univille, os animais juvenis são encontrados em maior quantidade nas praias brasileiras porque estão no primeiro ciclo migratório e são mais vulneráveis a ameaças naturais e humanas.

O desgaste da viagem pode fazer com que muitos cheguem ao litoral norte catarinense em estado crítico de saúde. Entre os problemas observados estão anemia, desidratação severa, hipotermia — quando a temperatura corporal fica abaixo do normal — e perda acentuada de massa corporal.

Os animais também podem ingerir lixo ou ficar presos em redes de pesca.

Os pinguins encontrados vivos e debilitados são resgatados e encaminhados à Unidade de Estabilização de Animais Marinhos da Univille, onde recebem atendimento especializado.

O que fazer ao encontrar um pinguim na praia?

O PMP-BS/Univille orienta que moradores acionem a equipe ao encontrar um pinguim na faixa de areia, mesmo que o animal pareça estar vivo e sem ferimentos aparentes.

A orientação é enviar uma foto do animal e a localização exata, além de seguir as recomendações da equipe.

Também é importante não tentar devolver o pinguim ao mar, não oferecer água ou comida, não colocá-lo no gelo ou em piscinas e manter animais domésticos afastados.

articles.title: Homem recebe multa por pilotar moto sem cinto de segurança | G1
articles.standfirst: O radialista de Guapiaçu (SP) recebeu notificação de infração cometida em Valinhos (SP), cidade onde ele alega nunca ter visitado.
articles.summary: A multa de moto sem cinto de segurança foi aplicada a um radialista de Guapiaçu por erro de digitação da PM de Valinhos e acabou cancelada pela prefeitura.
articles.body:
Morador de Guapiaçu (SP) recebe multa por andar sem cinto de segurança em moto — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

Um morador de Guapiaçu , no interior de São Paulo, foi surpreendido ao receber um aviso de autuação de trânsito por pilotar uma moto sem o cinto de segurança.

A notificação indicava que a infração teria ocorrido no dia 3 de outubro deste ano, na Rua Campos Salles, em Valinhos (SP), município onde o radialista e proprietário da motocicleta, Daniel Sávio Dias, afirma que nunca esteve.

Em entrevista ao g1 , Daniel contou que circula com o mesmo veículo há aproximadamente dez anos e se surpreendeu quando viu o registro de multa por meio do aplicativo CNH do Brasil.

"Minha primeira reação foi de surpresa, mas pensei comigo: 'Depois de tanto tempo, pode acontecer de cometer alguma infração por desatenção, mesmo tomando todos os cuidados'. No entanto, o detalhe é que sou motociclista e nunca tive um carro. Então, fiquei tentando entender como o dono de uma motocicleta poderia receber uma multa por falta de cinto de segurança", explica.

O radialista informou que acionou a Secretaria de Mobilidade Urbana de Valinhos por e-mail para contestar a autuação. O órgão enviou uma resposta orientando que ele preenchesse um requerimento e enviasse documentos para o início de um recurso administrativo.

No entanto, após a repercussão do caso por meio de um vídeo nas redes sociais, a Prefeitura de Valinhos informou que a multa já havia sido cancelada devido a uma inconsistência no sistema.

Segundo a administração municipal de Valinhos, a autuação foi elaborada por um policial militar e o veículo abordado originalmente era um carro.

De acordo com o poder público, houve um erro na identificação da placa durante o preenchimento ou a digitação dos dados, o que acabou vinculando a infração à motocicleta de Daniel.

"Levei tudo com muito bom humor desde o começo. Sabia que era um erro de digitação, não fazia sentido nenhum. Fico satisfeito que a prefeitura reconheceu a inconsistência e cancelou. Agora virou só uma história engraçada para contar", finaliza.

articles.title: Projeto de leitura leva 123 crianças ao palco em teatro de Teresina | G1
articles.standfirst: Iniciativa desenvolvida ao longo de cinco meses uniu literatura e cultura nordestina e levou alunos de 2 a 5 anos à estreia nos palcos.
articles.summary: Iniciativa desenvolvida ao longo de cinco meses uniu literatura e cultura nordestina e levou alunos de 2 a 5 anos à estreia nos palcos.
articles.body:
Com o objetivo de disseminar a literatura, uma escola de Teresina criou um projeto que incentiva a leitura por meio da contação de histórias, de músicas, desenhos, pinturas e atividades lúdicas. Nesta quarta-feira (14), 123 crianças de 2 a 5 anos se apresentaram no Teatro João Paulo II, na Zona Sudeste da capital, durante o encerramento do projeto.

Com o tema "Cantando os Encantos do Nordeste Brasileiro" , o projeto foi desenvolvido entre abril e outubro com oito turmas do Centro Municipal de Educação Infantil (CMEI) Tia Zoraide Almeida. Durante cinco meses, cada grupo trabalhou um aspecto da cultura nordestina para apresentar no encerramento.

Os alunos abordaram temas como a culinária nordestina, o livro "O Boi do Piauí", da escritora Márcia Evelyn, as músicas de Luiz Gonzaga e a literatura de cordel. As apresentações tiveram danças e terminaram com uma atividade coletiva que reuniu todas as crianças no palco.

Crianças apresentam cultura nordestina em encerramento de projeto de leitura em Teresina — Foto: Yngridy Vieira/g1

Segundo a diretora do CMEI, Nádia Marinho, o projeto busca estimular o hábito da leitura desde os primeiros anos de vida e aproximar os alunos das próprias raízes culturais.

“Escolhemos o tema Nordeste pelo fato de termos nos programado para encerrar em outubro, e aí, como o dia 8 de outubro é o Dia do Nordestino, a gente resolveu escolher essa temática que é riquíssima e é algo nosso. É importante que nossas crianças conheçam as nossas raízes”, destacou.

Projeto envolve famílias e comunidade escolar

Segundo Nádia Marinho, o projeto foi criado em 2023 e envolve professores, funcionários e familiares dos alunos. Neste ano, as atividades começaram em abril, na escola, e terminaram com a apresentação no teatro.

As atividades e os ensaios ocorreram no CMEI ao longo dos cinco meses do projeto. O evento desta quarta-feira marcou a primeira experiência das crianças em um palco. As famílias também ajudaram na preparação das apresentações e dos figurinos.

A professora Sávia Augusta, responsável por uma das turmas, explicou que as atividades foram adaptadas à idade das crianças e aos temas trabalhados por cada grupo.

“Na minha turma, as crianças trabalharam com a história do Boi do Piauí, de uma autora teresinense, Márcia Evelin. Então, a expectativa é muito grande de que essas crianças, elas possam continuar nesse universo da leitura, que hoje tem se perdido por conta das delas”, comentou.

Leitura contribui para o desenvolvimento infantil

A estudante de psicologia Maria Roberta Feitosa, estagiária do CMEI, afirmou que o projeto aproxima os livros do dia a dia das crianças por meio de atividades que vão além da leitura tradicional.

“É de extrema importância porque ele trabalha a leitura de uma forma mais lúdica com as crianças, em que elas podem entrar em contato com a nossa cultura”, explicou.

Os pais Janiele Oliveira e Itamar da Silva acompanharam a apresentação dos filhos, Ian e Iuri, de 3 e 5 anos. Para eles, a experiência foi emocionante por marcar a estreia das crianças em um teatro.

“Estamos muito felizes, emocionados também, porque nosso filho está entrando, introduzindo para o ano de leitura dele. Então é uma emoção muito grande”, relataram.

*Yngridy Vieira, estagiária sob supervisão de Ilanna Serena.

articles.title: Feirão de antena interna em Goiânia: ofertas no Shopping Cerrado | G1
articles.standfirst: Evento acontece de quinta-feira (15) a sábado (17), no Shopping Cerrado. Consumidores terão orientação sobre instalação, posicionamento da antena e busca de canais.
articles.summary: O feirão de antena interna em Goiânia oferece descontos e suporte técnico para instalação de TV digital no Shopping Cerrado entre os dias 15 e 17.
articles.body:
Shopping Cerrado, em Goiânia, recebe o Feirão Digital da Antena Interna entre os dias 15 e 17 de outubro, com descontos na compra de equipamentos. — Foto: Divulgação/Feirão Digital da Antena Interna

Um feirão de antenas internas para televisão digital será realizado entre quinta-feira (15) e sábado (17), no Shopping Cerrado, em Goiânia . O evento promete preços especiais e condições facilitadas de pagamento para quem deseja comprar o equipamento. O atendimento será das 10h às 22h, no piso térreo do shopping.

O Feirão Digital da Antena Interna é coordenado pela Associação Brasileira de Emissoras de Rádio e Televisão (Abert), em parceria com as empresas Intelbras e Aquário, com apoio da TV Anhanguera.

Segundo Pedro Augusto Pôssas, analista de Relações Institucionais da Globo e integrante da coordenação do projeto pela Abert, os consumidores também receberão orientações para instalar e utilizar os equipamentos.

"As pessoas serão orientadas quanto à melhor forma de posicionar a antena e como efetuar a busca de canais", explicou.

A antena interna permite captar o sinal aberto da televisão digital sem a necessidade de contratar serviços de TV por assinatura. Segundo Pedro, televisores fabricados depois de 2010 que já possuem conversor digital integrado não precisam de um aparelho adicional para utilizar a antena.

No entanto, o funcionamento depende das condições de recepção do sinal no local onde a televisão está instalada.

"Limitação sempre pode haver, exatamente por ser uma antena interna, dependendo dos obstáculos entre a antena e a torre da TV", explicou.

Por isso, a posição da antena dentro da residência pode influenciar a qualidade da recepção. Durante o feirão, os consumidores poderão tirar dúvidas sobre o posicionamento adequado e a busca dos canais disponíveis.

Pedro também destacou que a televisão digital aberta oferece melhor qualidade de imagem e som, sem cobrança de mensalidade.

"A TV digital tem melhor som, melhor imagem e é de graça", destacou Pedro.

De acordo com a organização, não haverá limite de antenas por consumidor. Apesar de o estoque disponível para retirada imediata ser limitado, será possível realizar compras com entrega posterior. A Intelbras vai comercializar três modelos de antenas internas durante o feirão, com 20% de desconto. A principal diferença entre os produtos é o comprimento do cabo. Os preços de cada modelo ainda não foram informados.

O feirão será realizado em frente à loja Polo Wear, no piso térreo do Shopping Cerrado, localizado no Setor Aeroviário.

articles.summary: Formação será realizada de 19 a 23 de outubro, em São Luís, com atividades voltadas ao bem-estar e aos desafios da vida acadêmica.
articles.body:
Curso gratuito de saúde mental para estudantes de pós-graduação tem inscrições abertas no MA — Foto: Divulgação/Governo do Maranhão

Estão abertas as inscrições para uma nova turma do programa Cuidado em Saúde Mental na Pós-Graduação do Maranhão. O curso é gratuito e voltado a estudantes de pós-graduação e bolsistas da Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa e ao Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico do Maranhão (Fapema).

Os interessados podem se inscrever até o dia 27 de outubro, pelo site eventos.fapema.br. A formação será realizada de 19 a 23 de outubro, das 8h às 13h, na Fundação Escola de Governo do Maranhão (EGMA), em São Luís .

A programação inclui aulas teóricas e práticas sobre autoconhecimento, gestão das emoções, relações interpessoais, carreira acadêmica e atividades voltadas ao bem-estar.

O objetivo é ajudar os participantes a lidar com desafios comuns da pós-graduação, como a pressão por produtividade, a sobrecarga de estudos e o isolamento social.

Além das aulas, o programa oferece acompanhamento psicoterapêutico aos participantes interessados e atividades de movimento e socialização, com foco no autocuidado e na adoção de hábitos saudáveis.

A iniciativa é promovida pela Fapema, em parceria com a EGMA.

articles.title: Morador recebe conta de água de R$ 21 mil após pagar R$ 184 em Santos | G1
articles.standfirst: Após procurar o Procon, consumidor teve fatura revisada para R$ 264. Sabesp informou que recalculou o valor com base na média de consumo da residência.
articles.summary: Após procurar o Procon, consumidor teve fatura revisada para R$ 264. Sabesp informou que recalculou o valor com base na média de consumo da residência.
articles.body:
Morador de Santos recebeu conta de água no valor de R$ 21.299,08. — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

Uma conta de água de R$ 21.299,08 surpreendeu um morador do bairro Saboó, em Santos , no litoral de São Paulo. A cobrança de setembro foi 11.460% maior que os R$ 184,18 do mês anterior e, após uma reclamação, foi revisada pela Companhia de Saneamento Básico do Estado de São Paulo (Sabesp) para R$ 264,23.

O auxiliar técnico de educação, de 35 anos, afirmou ao g1 que tentou contato com a Sabesp diversas vezes e conseguiu a revisão após registrar uma reclamação no Programa de Proteção e Defesa do Consumidor (Procon), em 10 de setembro.

Em nota, a Sabesp informou que atendeu à solicitação do cliente e revisou a fatura de setembro de 2026 com base na média de consumo da residência. A companhia acrescentou que está monitorando o imóvel e que uma nova leitura, realizada em outubro, indicou normalidade na medição.

Ao g1 , o morador contou que vive com a filha e a sobrinha e enfrenta problemas com os valores das contas de água há cerca de um ano. Segundo ele, as faturas, que antes ficavam em torno de R$ 90, passaram a chegar a aproximadamente R$ 450.

Ele disse que chegou a ficar sete meses sem pagar as faturas por não conseguir arcar com os valores cobrados. Mesmo após a revisão da conta de setembro, o consumidor afirmou que recebeu uma nova cobrança de R$ 390 em outubro e registrou outra reclamação no Procon.

Segundo o morador, a Sabesp mencionou a possibilidade de erro na leitura e informou que fará a troca do hidrômetro, equipamento que mede o consumo de água do imóvel.

Ele afirmou, porém, que ainda não recebeu esclarecimentos sobre uma eventual revisão das contas anteriores.

"A Sabesp disse que vai trocar o relógio, mas não fala nada de revisar as contas", afirmou.

Morador relatou que as contas começaram a aumentar no último ano — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

“A Sabesp esclarece que atendeu ao solicitado pelo cliente, referente à fatura de setembro/2026, e o valor foi revisado de acordo com a média da residência. A Companhia está monitorando o consumo do imóvel e a nova leitura realizada este mês já indicou a normalidade na medição do consumo de água.

A Sabesp reafirma seu compromisso com a transparência, o diálogo institucional e a prestação adequada dos serviços públicos concedidos. E informa, ainda, que as tratativas foram realizadas dentro dos procedimentos administrativos da Companhia e os esclarecimentos solicitados foram feitos dentro do prazo estabelecido pelo órgão de Defesa do Consumidor."

articles.title: Pessoas em situação de rua podem ficar sem abrigo em Nova Friburgo | G1
articles.standfirst: Prefeitura afirma que atendimento será mantido pelo menos até a próxima semana, após entendimento com a Defensoria Pública.
articles.summary: Prefeitura afirma que atendimento será mantido pelo menos até a próxima semana, após entendimento com a Defensoria Pública.
articles.body:
O possível fechamento do abrigo para pessoas em situação de rua em Nova Friburgo , na Região Serrana do Rio, reacendeu a preocupação sobre a falta de alternativas de acolhimento para quem não tem onde morar.

Localizado na Alameda Barão de Taunay, em Olaria, o espaço faz parte da rede municipal de assistência e atende pessoas que precisam de um lugar seguro para se proteger e descansar.

Entre elas está Mateus Modesto, conhecido como Gigante de Nova Friburgo. Sem casa e sem familiares que possam recebê-lo, ele conta que procurou o serviço para conseguir acolhimento, mas foi informado de que o espaço não receberia novos usuários naquele momento e que voltaria a funcionar durante o inverno.

Mateus fez um apelo ao prefeito Johnny Maycon para que o atendimento seja mantido. A preocupação é que, sem uma alternativa, pessoas que dependem do serviço precisem voltar a dormir nas ruas, expostas à chuva, ao frio e à violência.

A reportagem também recebeu relatos sobre a presença de pessoas em situação de rua na região da rodoviária urbana, no Centro da cidade, e sobre o risco de aumento dessa população no local.

O abrigo foi criado como parte do Plano de Inverno da Prefeitura e tem caráter temporário. Segundo a Secretaria Municipal de Desenvolvimento Social e Direitos Humanos, o encerramento estava previsto para a primeira quinzena de setembro, mas o funcionamento foi ampliado por causa das condições de temperatura.

Após questionamentos da reportagem, a Prefeitura informou que, depois de um entendimento com a Defensoria Pública do Estado do Rio de Janeiro, o atendimento será mantido pelo menos até a próxima semana.

A Secretaria também afirmou que realiza encaminhamentos para o aluguel social, conforme a adesão de cada pessoa, e que o plano de contingência prevê a abertura do abrigo em situações de chuva intensa, frio intenso e outras condições climáticas adversas.

A continuidade do atendimento e o fechamento programado serão discutidos em uma reunião do Comitê Intersetorial de Acompanhamento e Monitoramento da Política Nacional para a População em Situação de Rua (CIAMP), marcada para quinta-feira (15).

A discussão sobre o atendimento à população em situação de rua em Nova Friburgo não é recente. A Defensoria Pública já recorreu à Justiça para cobrar melhorias nos serviços oferecidos pelo município e a estruturação de uma rede de acolhimento com condições dignas.

Em 2022 , a instituição acionou a Justiça após o fechamento de pontos de apoio e cobrou a oferta de acolhimento com alimentação, higiene e segurança.

Em 2025 , a Defensoria voltou a apontar problemas no atendimento à população em situação de rua, incluindo dificuldades de acesso aos serviços. A Justiça determinou medidas para garantir atendimento às pessoas que procurassem o Centro POP e melhorias na estrutura de acolhimento.

Em fevereiro de 2026 , a Defensoria informou à Justiça que parte das determinações anteriores ainda não havia sido cumprida integralmente. A instituição também solicitou o bloqueio de recursos municipais relacionados às multas por descumprimento das decisões.

O pedido de bloqueio não significa, necessariamente, que os recursos tenham sido efetivamente bloqueados.

A reportagem solicitou à Defensoria esclarecimentos sobre o entendimento firmado com a Prefeitura, incluindo se houve algum compromisso formal para manter o abrigo aberto e quais medidas podem ser adotadas caso o atendimento seja encerrado sem uma alternativa permanente.

O Centro de Referência Especializado para População em Situação de Rua, conhecido como Centro POP, é um serviço da assistência social que oferece atendimento especializado, orientação, encaminhamentos e apoio para que pessoas em situação de rua tenham acesso a direitos e a outros serviços públicos.

O equipamento, porém, não é necessariamente um abrigo para passar a noite. O acolhimento noturno deve ser oferecido por serviços específicos, como abrigos institucionais e casas de passagem.

Por isso, a discussão em Nova Friburgo envolve não apenas o funcionamento dos serviços de assistência social, mas também a existência de alternativas para quem precisa de um lugar para dormir durante todo o ano.

A principal questão é como garantir proteção e acolhimento às pessoas em situação de rua mesmo fora do período de inverno.

articles.title: IFRN abre 1.224 vagas em cursos técnicos gratuitos no RN; veja como se inscrever | G1
articles.standfirst: Oportunidades são para quem já concluiu o ensino médio e para pessoas que desejam retomar os estudos pela Educação de Jovens e Adultos (EJA).
articles.summary: Oportunidades são para quem já concluiu o ensino médio e para pessoas que desejam retomar os estudos pela Educação de Jovens e Adultos (EJA).
articles.body:
Vagas são destinadas també para quem quer voltar a estudar — Foto: IFRN/Divulgação

O Instituto Federal do Rio Grande do Norte (IFRN) está com inscrições abertas para 1.224 vagas em cursos técnicos de nível médio para ingresso em 2027. As oportunidades estão distribuídas em diferentes unidades e contemplam pessoas que já concluíram o ensino médio e aquelas que desejam voltar a estudar.

As inscrições podem ser feitas até as 23h59 do dia 9 de novembro , exclusivamente pelo site processoseletivo.ifrn.edu.br . A seleção será feita por sorteio eletrônico.

Do total de vagas, 828 são para cursos técnicos subsequentes, destinados a quem já concluiu o ensino médio. As outras 396 são para a modalidade integrada à Educação de Jovens e Adultos (EJA), que permite concluir o ensino médio e obter formação técnica ao mesmo tempo.

Vagas para quem já concluiu o ensino médio

As 828 vagas para cursos técnicos subsequentes estão distribuídas nos campi João Câmara, Mossoró, Natal -Central, Natal-Centro Histórico, Natal-Zona Norte, Nova Cruz, Parnamirim, São Gonçalo do Amarante e São Paulo do Potengi.

Entre as áreas oferecidas estão agroindústria e panificação. A taxa de inscrição é de R$ 25. Os candidatos que atenderem aos critérios previstos no edital podem solicitar isenção do pagamento entre os dias 13 e 25 de outubro.

Vagas para quem quer concluir o ensino médio

As outras 396 vagas são para cursos técnicos integrados à modalidade EJA. A oferta é destinada a pessoas que concluíram o ensino fundamental e desejam terminar o ensino médio junto com uma formação profissional.

Podem concorrer candidatos com certificado de conclusão do ensino fundamental ou curso equivalente e que tenham, no mínimo, 18 anos completos até o último dia do período de matrícula.

Os cursos são oferecidos nos campi Currais Novos, Ipanguaçu, João Câmara, Lajes, Macau, Natal-Zona Norte, Nova Cruz, Pau dos Ferros e São Gonçalo do Amarante.

Entre as opções estão Mineração, Petróleo e Gás e Produção de Áudio e Vídeo. Para essa modalidade, a inscrição é gratuita.

Prazo: até 9 de novembro de 2026, às 23h59.

articles.title: French newspaper claims climate change is fueling child marriages, including girls as young as 12
articles.summary: A French newspaper claims climate change accelerates child marriage in Bangladesh and other nations, drawing sharp criticism from Moms for Liberty.
articles.body: A French newspaper claimed Tuesday that climate change is accelerating child marriages in developing countries, including among girls as young as 12, citing research suggesting that natural disasters are pushing impoverished families to marry off their daughters at increasingly younger ages. Le Parisien's report, "She was only 12: Climate change, a new accelerator of child marriage," directly linked weather-related disasters to early marriages in Bangladesh, Kenya and other countries. "In Bangladesh, Kenya and elsewhere, climate disasters are worsening child marriages," the newspaper said in a passage translated from French. "By destroying incomes and homes, they push some families to marry off their daughters at increasingly younger ages." ALASKA STATE FAIR BARS PARENTAL RIGHTS GROUP DUE TO 'EXTREMIST' GROUP DESIGNATION BY FAR-LEFT ORGANIZATION The article drew criticism from Moms for Liberty CEO and co-founder Tina Descovich, who told Fox News Digital attributing child marriage to climate change shifts responsibility away from those exploiting children. "Blaming climate change for the abhorrent practice of marrying off girls as young as 12 sounds absolutely wild … but it’s just the latest absurd excuse for disgusting behavior, shifting responsibility onto the environment instead of the people and ideologies that choose to exploit children," Descovich said. "At Moms for Liberty, we see this same mentality every day in America, where activists blame society, systems or external factors for harming kids rather than demanding strong families, parental rights, and personal accountability that actually protect our children." TALIBAN WIPES OUT DECADES OF PROGRESS AS 2.4M AFGHAN GIRLS REMAIN LOCKED OUT OF SCHOOL, UN AGENCY SAYS The French newspaper based much of its reporting on Plan International's 2026 report, which examined the relationship between climate-related disasters and child marriage. Researchers surveyed 5,000 girls and young women across Bangladesh, Kenya, Peru, Senegal and Zimbabwe. According to Le Parisien, 36% reported observing increased child marriage after climate-related disasters, while 11% said they had personally experienced child marriage. Fox News Digital reached out to Le Parisien and Plan International for comment but did not immediately receive a response. The newspaper highlighted the case of a 12-year-old Bangladeshi girl who was reportedly married off four days after boys harassed her inside a cyclone shelter. According to a teenage friend interviewed by the outlet, the girl later gave birth to a baby who died, leaving her with serious health complications. AMERICANS TRAVEL TO PAKISTAN TO FREE CHRISTIANS TRAPPED IN MODERN-DAY SLAVERY: 'GOD'S HAND WAS IN IT' Another case involved Runa, a 15-year-old Bangladeshi girl whose widowed mother arranged her marriage after a cyclone destroyed a family's livestock and income. Runa described during a July interview with Australia's ABC News how the marriage interrupted her education. "I did not want to get married," Runa said. "I wanted to continue my education. The decision made me feel very sad and helpless." However, Runa was eventually allowed to return to school with assistance from aid organizations after her husband's family agreed to let her resume her education, according to ABC News. Now 17 and a mother, Runa said returning to her studies had given her renewed hope for the future. Child marriage was already widespread in Bangladesh before the latest report. According to UNICEF's 2025 survey, 47.2% of women ages 20 to 24 were married before turning 18, down from 51.4% in 2019. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE UNICEF identifies poverty, entrenched gender norms, harmful traditional practices, barriers to education and climate-related disasters among the factors contributing to child marriage. Bangladesh's 2017 Child Marriage Restraint Act generally prohibits marriage for girls younger than 18, although the law includes an exception allowing underage marriages with parental consent and court approval under special circumstances. Plan International maintains that climate-related disasters created additional financial pressures on families, particularly those dependent on agriculture and livestock. Tanushree Soni, a Plan International representative, previously explained the economic circumstances behind child marriages during an interview with ABC News. "Financial stress is the trigger," Soni said. "The families look to lessen the burden because they don't consider girls to be part of their own families." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP The research describes a relationship between weather-related disasters and child marriage, although the survey findings alone do not establish that human-caused climate change directly caused the individual marriages described in the newspaper's report.

articles.title: 'When I moved to China': Major row over Katie Zacharia's calling herself a lawyer; only citizens can get a license to practise law in China
articles.summary: A major row erupted over White House's new press secretary Katie Zacharia, calling herself a lawyer because experts said she is not.
articles.body: A major row erupted over White House's new press secretary Katie Zacharia, calling herself a lawyer because experts said she is not. Zacharia has a law degree from the Pepperdine Caruso School of Law, but there’s no evidence she ever passed a bar exam. “Where did she pass the bar exam? Which state?” a reporter asked Trump on Tuesday, who turned to Zacharia to ask her, “which state?”“When I moved to China,” Zacharia responded.But it's still not clear which bar exam she took as only citizens can become licenced to practice law in China. On her LinkedIn, she lists herself as "general counsel" for the activist group Fix California. She also listed Zhong Lun Law Firm in Beijing as her workplace for nearly two years starting in 2011.The White House said Katie moved to China with her husband after graduation because of his job at an American private equity firm while she worked on international transaction law.The US states where she lived in have no record of Zacharia as having a licence to practise law. The State Bar of California has no record of Kate Sharon Zacharia or Kate Sharon Black having been licensed to practice law in California,” a spokesperson for the California State Bar told CNN in a statement, referring to her maiden name. “Due to confidentiality requirements, the State Bar can only confirm whether someone passed the bar exam, not whether they took the bar exam.”Did she ever pass a bar exam?Pepperdine University’s Caruso Law School congratulated Zacharia on the appointment, noting she was both an alumna and a member of its Dean’s Council. But it's not clear whether she passed the bar exam. “I practiced international transaction law, with all the appropriate credentials," she told NewsNation on a question about the bar exam.'I moved to China around the same time...'Jared Nelson, CEO of Pathway Compliance, shed some light on the internal workings of Chinese law firms and said that he also moved to China to work at a law firm around the same time Zacharia moved. He said when he joined, his bar exam results were pending and until the results came out he had a limited role and strict supervision by a licensed lawyer. "Her statements of “practicing law”, being a “lawyer”, or acting as “general counsel” would very likely be an unauthorized practice of law violation if she was not admitted to the bar somewhere," Nelson explained, adding that the firm Zacharia worked is a prestigious Chinese firm and they would not have done anything illegal.He added that it is also possible that she never sat for the bar and worked in a reduced role at the Chinese firm. "Chinese law firms hire foreign talent to work in those roles all of the time, there is a lot of work happening in a law firm that doesn’t require a license, whether it is a local license in China or abroad, and they add a lot of value in other areas," Nelson explained.You use AI every day. articles.title: Joe Bartolozzi reveals what ‘freaks’ him out about streamers as he questions their off-camera behaviour
articles.summary: Joe Bartolozzi has shared his concerns about streamers who act like different people when the cameras are off.
articles.body: Joe Bartolozzi has shared his concerns about streamers who act like different people when the cameras are off. During a recent livestream, the internet personality spoke about meeting content creators whose real-life behavior surprised him. He also criticized streamers who bother people in public and later defend their actions as entertainment. A clip from his livestream was shared by X user @yoxics on October 13, 2026. Bartolozzi did not name the creators he criticized, but he explained why he prefers people who can separate their online characters from their real personalities.Joe Bartolozzi Explains Why Fake Streamer Personalities Bother HimBartolozzi recalled meeting two streamers who seemed completely different from the people viewers saw online. He said their personalities changed so much that it felt like someone had flipped a switch.“I've met maybe two streamers ever, where I meet them and they are not the same person at all! And it's freaky. Like, it's a switch. Like some ****** personality flips ya. I'm not saying who. Some personality flip ****, and that freaks you the **** out.”He then mentioned Martin, making it clear that he was not talking about him. Bartolozzi praised Martin for being a kind person away from the camera, even though he plays a character during his streams.“Martin is awesome! Okay, Martin locks into a character on-stream, but Martin is dead*** just like a wholesome guy. I love Martin. Like, I'm so happy I got to meet Martin at Streamer Games; he's so nice.”Bartolozzi also shared his thoughts on creators who approach strangers in public, bother them for reactions and claim they are only making content.He explained that he would rather such streamers behave normally in real life. That would suggest they understand the difference between doing something for a video and treating people badly in everyday situations.“You know what I would rather it be? And this is my worry - like, these guys that go out in public and harass people and say it's just content, if I met them in person, I'd rather... would it be better if they were normal or identical? I'd rather them be normal. Because then there is still like a part of them that's like, 'I'm just doing this as a job.' Like, it'd be worse if they were the same off-camera because then they're just a ****-head.”Joe Bartolozzi Praises Stable Ronaldo for Knowing Where to Draw the LineBartolozzi also brought up Rani “Stable Ronaldo” while explaining the difference between playing a character and taking things too far for views.He described Ronaldo as someone who often tries to create funny moments that can be turned into short clips. However, Bartolozzi believes the streamer understands when to stop and respects the people around him.“The best example is Ron. Ron is a very clip-farming guy, but I don't think Ron crosses the line into 'It's just content.' Like, Ron still knows the line with the person he's with. Does that make sense?”Bartolozzi explained that Ronaldo behaves differently depending on who he is spending time with. Still, he said that difference does not mean Ronaldo is pretending to be someone else when the cameras are off.“If Ron is just with Yugi, or Ron is just with people in the Clover House, Ron will act different than if he's with me. But when Ron is not streaming, like, before the Streamer Games start, we're all just talking - he's still the same guy - just not clip-farming. But it's just like a regular *** conversation.”Ronaldo has not publicly responded to Bartolozzi's comments as of the time of writing. articles.title: Bangladesh arrests two for luring locals to fight for Russia in Ukraine
articles.summary: Twenty Bangladeshi citizens have been killed after being used by Russia as ‘bait’ to locate enemy positions, police say.
articles.body:
Police in Bangladesh have arrested two people they say are linked to a trafficking network that deceptively recruited locals to fight for Russia in Ukraine.

The suspects, identified as Mizanur Rahman and Abu Taher, trafficked at least 30 people to Russia with false promises of high-paying jobs, Mohammad Asaduzzaman, commander of the elite police force Special Response Battalion, said on Wednesday.

Once abroad, the victims’ passports and phones were taken, and they were handed over to the Russian military, he said.

Seventeen of the trafficking victims, who arrived in Russia in early May, were killed on the first day of deployment after being given minimal training, Asaduzzaman said. A total of 20 Bangladeshis have been confirmed dead.

“Bangladeshis were used as bait to locate enemy positions,” he said. “Russian forces determined their next course of action after the Bangladeshis fell victim to drone attacks.”

In addition to the 20 Bangladeshis killed, two more are being treated in a Moscow hospital while six others are still on the battlefield, police cited a survivor who was injured and managed to return home as saying.

The victims were from poor backgrounds and had paid around $8,000 for the fake jobs that brought them to Russia, Bangladeshi media reported.

Both Russia and Ukraine have recruited thousands of foreign nationals into their armies since Russia launched its invasion of Ukraine four and a half years ago.

An estimated 28,000 foreigners from 136 countries are said to be fighting in the Russian army, and officials believe Moscow deployed some 14,000 North Korean troops to battle Ukraine’s 2024 incursion into the Kursk region.

Meanwhile, Ukraine says 16,000 foreign nationals from more than 70 countries – including nearly 40 percent from Latin America – are currently serving in its army.

Speaking at the United Nations General Assembly last month , Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that Russia deceptively recruits people from 47 countries for an “absolutely brutal” campaign and urged countries not to let Moscow “drag” them into the war.

Amnesty International has also accused Russia of using “deceptive, coercive and exploitative practices” to recruit foreigners to fight on the Ukrainian front.

Russia has previously dismissed accusations of coercing foreigners into joining its army.

Amnesty says it cannot conduct inquiries about foreigners in Ukraine’s army as it has no access to prisoners of war held in Russia, which designates the rights group as a “foreign agent”.

articles.title: Zelensky says he feels betrayed by Trump after Russia fuel deal
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he felt betrayed after US President Donald Trump announced a new deal to buy Russian fuel from Moscow last week.
articles.body: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said he felt betrayed after US President Donald Trump announced a new deal to buy Russian fuel from Moscow last week. When asked by British media personality Piers Morgan if he had been “betrayed” by the Trump administration, Zelensky answered, “Yes,” describing the agreement as a “simple victory” for the Kremlin. “It’s a pity that we are losing a strong partner,” the Ukrainian president told Morgan on Wednesday during his YouTube talk show, “Piers Morgan Uncensored.” Last week, Trump wrote on social media that Russia’s President Vladimir Putin agreed to supply markets with his country’s diesel fuel as the US president works to bring down energy costs ahead of the midterm elections. That move drew bipartisan criticism and sparked anger among European allies. On Monday, Russian forces launched fresh attacks on Ukraine just hours after the US president stated an “energy ceasefire” had come into effect – a measure that neither Moscow nor Kyiv had publicly confirmed. In a clip shared on X from the interview with Morgan, the Ukrainian president said: “This is our country, our body, our home, our children… That’s why it’s painful when Trump chooses one side.” “If you’re in the middle, you have to stay in the middle. Not on the wrong side,” said Zelensky. “This is not the right side of history.” “Russia wants him (Trump) to be weak,” he added. “They don’t care about elections in the United States.” Both Russian and Ukrainian troops have intensified aerial attacks on each other’s energy infrastructure in recent weeks, as movements on the battlefield remain relatively stagnant. The Trump administration had warned Ukraine and allies in Europe that the US could suspend intelligence sharing and European purchases of US weapons for Kyiv if it did not halt deep strikes on Russian energy facilities. Information sharing is invaluable to Ukrainian defense efforts against Russian ballistic missile attacks by giving the locations of missile launchers along with data on where the strikes are being directed, and when. In the days that followed, Trump administration officials, including the president, insisted such intelligence sharing continued. But what explained the lack of missile warnings? When asked by Kyiv for an explanation, US officials blamed the weather. But Ukrainian officials suspected it was deliberate. “America says it was a failure,” a European official told CNN. “But it can’t be the truth.” “This will give Russians a real leverage on a frontline at the time when we effectively stopped their advances, and de-occupy the territories,” a Ukrainian official told CNN. ‘People will die’ That information deficit has been compounded by Elon Musk’s Starlink curbing some internet services in Ukraine, according to local officials. Ukrainian authorities said they were caught off-guard by restrictions on the military-grade version of Elon Musk’s Starlink, called Starshield. Zelensky claimed Russian forces were trying to capitalize on the Starlink disruption by unleashing heavy strikes overnight, telling Morgan that Ukrainian forces use the software to defend against Moscow’s jet-powered Shahed drones. “It’s a big mistake,” he said during the interview on Wednesday. “This decision will bring a lot of human losses… People will die,” Zelensky said. “My message (to Musk) is absolutely clear. I hope it’s a mistake, a huge technical problem. We’re asking (him) to switch on (the service).” Musk on Wednesday said Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government and that any limits on its speed or usage are up to the US military and president. He added that Starlink is a commercial service owned and controlled by SpaceX and is limited to civilian or defensive activities. Musk said Starlink “cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company.” Zelensky has spent the past week trying to shore up support among European leaders. On Wednesday, he met Britain’s Prime Minister Andy Burnham and King Charles over two separate meetings in London – just as he Kremlin fired drones and ballistic miles that left more than 600,000 people in Ukraine without power, according to Zelensky.

articles.title: A couple sold their luxury belongings to buy a $1,500 van; their fruit-tree gifting business now generates more than $4 million a year
articles.summary: Mickey and Vicky Popat turned a shared love of gardening into PlantOGram, a fruit-tree gifting company that generated $4.2 million in annual revenue in
articles.body: Mickey and Vicky Popat turned a shared love of gardening into PlantOGram, a fruit-tree gifting company that generated $4.2 million in annual revenue in 2024. The Florida-based couple began with a modest investment, selling their luxury belongings to purchase a used van and take their business idea forward. What started with fruit trees in their backyard gradually developed into an online business serving customers across the US and international markets. Their journey highlights how a simple personal interest can grow into a substantial business through persistence and practical decisions.Selling luxury belongings built a $4 million fruit-tree gifting businessThe Popats' business idea emerged from their experience growing fruit trees at home in Orlando, Florida. According to Entrepreneur, Mickey Popat worked in finance, while Vicky was a teacher. Their weekend gardening hobby eventually resulted in more than 80 fruit trees in their backyard, including varieties that introduced friends and family to tropical fruits they had not encountered before.Mickey had grown up enjoying fruits such as guavas, mangoes and lychees after immigrating to the United States from South Africa in the early 1990s. When visitors tasted the fruit grown at the couple's home, they became interested in growing trees of their own. articles.title: A retired Georgia farmer began turning old tin, bicycle parts and scrap metal into homemade figures; over the next two decades hundreds filled his roadside property before his discarded-material art reached museums
articles.summary: When severe glaucoma forced Reuben Aaron Miller to stop working as a farmer and preacher at the age of 65, he turned to scrap metal and wood to keep
articles.body: When severe glaucoma forced Reuben Aaron Miller to stop working as a farmer and preacher at the age of 65, he turned to scrap metal and wood to keep himself busy. At his home in Rabbittown, near Gainesville, Georgia, Miller began making wind-powered whirligigs, cut-out animal figures and hand-painted tin signs. Over the next 20 years, hundreds of his handmade creations filled his roadside yard. The rural property became a local landmark and later attracted international art collectors and major museums. According to biographical information published by the New Georgia Encyclopedia and his Wikipedia profile, Miller spent almost his entire life on the same piece of land where he was born in July 1912.From farm work to roadside artMiller's early life was marked by hardship. Six months before he was born, his father was shot dead during a dispute over land involving a public road. His mother raised him and his seven siblings alone. Miller left school at the age of 12 to work in a local cotton mill and chop firewood, earning 50 cents for each load. He later became an ordained minister in the Free Will Baptist Church while continuing to work as a farmer. After retiring in the late 1970s, Miller began making whirligigs like those he had built as a young boy. Using simple tools, paint and felt-tip markers, he created figures from old tin sheets, broken bicycle parts, aluminium cans and scrap wood. He displayed his finished work across his lawn and beside the road, selling pieces directly to passing motorists. Prices ranged from $5 to $50.Iconic characters and religious messagesReligion and everyday life were major influences on Miller's art. Many of his cut-out metal figures carried short messages written by hand. One of his best-known phrases was "Lord Love You." Biographical records from the Georgia Museum of Art show that his subjects included angels, devils, chickens, pigs, snakes and different types of dinosaurs. Some of the dinosaurs were inspired by nature documentaries he watched on television. He also made figures of well-known cultural characters, including Elvis Presley and Uncle Sam, alongside unusual people wearing top hats or smoking cigars. One of his most recognisable designs was a figure called "Blow Oskar." It was based on his cousin, who regularly honked his car horn while driving past Miller's house. At first, some people in the local community questioned the value of his growing collection. Their views changed when they saw that he could make money from his work. "When he first started, we all laughed at him and said 'Who wants that junk?' When he started making money, we all wanted to help," a neighbour recalled, according to statements preserved in reports by The Gainesville Times.National exposure and R.E.M. collaborationMiller's work began attracting attention beyond his local community in the mid-1980s, following a notable collaboration with Georgia rock band R.E.M. Director and painter James Herbert filmed Miller's moving whirligigs and lawn sculptures for Left of Reckoning, a 20-minute short film made for the band. Parts of Miller's outdoor art display also appeared in the official music video for R.E.M.'s song "Pretty Persuasion". This brought his unusual artistic style to a national television audience. By the early 2000s, Miller's sculptures had appeared on the cover of TV Guide magazine. The exposure brought art dealers, tourists and visitors from other countries to his property in Rabbittown. His work, which had once sold for just a few dollars, began fetching between $700 and $800 in art galleries.Institutional recognition and legacyMiller died in March 2006 at the age of 93. After his death, museums and other institutions began giving greater attention to his artistic work. In 2006, Brenau University's Simmons Visual Arts Center held a memorial exhibition called "R.A. Miller: A Tribute." Three years later, in 2009, the Georgia Museum of Art organised a larger retrospective titled "Lord Love You: Works by R.A. Miller from the Mullis Collection." The exhibition featured 83 paintings, drawings and moving sculptures. Miller's creations are now held in permanent public collections across the United States. These include the Art Museum of Southeast Texas in Beaumont, where his work remains part of the country's recognised folk-art heritage.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. articles.title: Parts of Ontario move to permanent daylight saving time to avoid disruption for businesses and families. What will happen on November 1?
articles.summary: The Ontario government announced that it will be making daylight saving time permanent in parts of northwestern Ontario to keep in sync with Manitoba
articles.body: The Ontario government announced that it will be making daylight saving time permanent in parts of northwestern Ontario to keep in sync with Manitoba because Manitoba said they will switch to permanent daylight saving time on November 1. Ontario says the recently announced change for northwestern Ontario will keep that region aligned with Manitoba, avoiding disruption for businesses, families and Indigenous communities in Ontario’s central time zone.“Maintaining alignment with Manitoba would help businesses operate more efficiently across provincial boundaries, while making it easier for residents and service providers to coordinate activities such as health-care appointments and travel,” the government said.“Providing certainty and predictability is essential to supporting strong communities and a competitive economy,” Attorney General Doug Downey said in a statement. “By keeping this part of the province aligned with Manitoba, our government is taking a practical … approach to avoid unnecessary disruptions and ensure economic stability in communities that reside in Ontario’s central time zone.”In daylight saving time, clocks are changed twice a year: In spring, clocks move forward by one hour; in autumn, clocks move back by one hour.Ontario has two time zones. Toronto, Ottawa, Hamilton, Mississauga and most of Ontario come under ET. partnes of northwestern Ontario including kenora and Fort Frances come under Central Time. Under the proposed change, affected communities in northwestern Ontario that currently change their clocks seasonally would not need to turn them back on Nov. 1. The affected communities in Ontario’s Central Time Zone, include Kenora, Dryden, Fort Frances, Sioux Lookout, Red Lake and Rainy River. Communities in the Eastern Time Zone, such as Thunder Bay, will continue to fall back one hour on November 1st. That’s in line with the rest of Ontario, which is in the Eastern Time Zone.Ontario has considered the switch to permanent daylight saving time for the entire province in The Time Amendment Act, 2020. But that legislation is not yet in force. For that to happen, Ontario says neighbouring Quebec and New York would have to make the change too.British Columbia said in March that it was moving to permanent Pacific daylight time. Alberta also switched to permanent daylight time this year in what it calls Alberta time, which means it now has the same time as Saskatchewan year-round. articles.title: Cartels use drones to scout border agents and map smuggling routes, expert warns
articles.summary: The U.S. military detected 378 cartel drone incursions along the Mexico border in 30 days, and experts warn cartels will continue to innovate.
articles.body: MEXICO CITY — Mexican cartels are said to be using commercial and modified drones to watch U.S. security personnel, map patrol routines and support smuggling corridors along the southern border as authorities expand efforts to disable the aircraft. The U.S. military detected 378 drone incursions along the border during the previous 30 days, Brig. Gen. Brian Filler of Joint Task Force-Southern Border recently told reporters. He said the trend was increasing, and the aircraft were typically commercial drones with cameras used for surveillance tied to smuggling and human trafficking. "On the border, the most common application is surveillance and reconnaissance as cartels look to establish a pattern of life for U.S. security personnel and support smuggling outcomes across the border," Austin Doctor told Fox News Digital. Doctor directs strategic initiatives at the National Counterterrorism Innovation, Technology and Education Center and teaches criminology and criminal justice at the University of Nebraska at Omaha. US MILITARY LAUNCHES FIRST AUTONOMOUS WARFARE COMMAND TO DEPLOY UNMANNED SYSTEMS ACROSS LATIN AMERICA A U.S. Customs and Border Protection spokesperson confirmed the growing threat, telling Fox News Digital, "Rapidly advancing Unmanned Aircraft System technology presents persistent threats, including counter-surveillance, illicit cargo movement and potential kinetic attacks. "Cartels increasingly exploit UAS for surveillance, illicit activities, monitoring law enforcement, scouting crossing points and coordinating smuggling operations. CBP detected over 42,000 near-border UAS flights in (fiscal 2025) and over 37,000 in (fiscal 2026), underscoring the scale of this challenge. "Under congressional authority (6 USC 124n), the Department of Homeland Security has approved Counter-UAS authorities for CBP. U.S. Border Patrol C-UAS operations, with DHS Secretary approval, cover the entire Southwest border and areas extending 100 miles inland for detection, identification, monitoring, and tracking of UASs. USBP C-UAS operates in all Southwest border sectors to detect, track, and mitigate these threats." Doctor explained how the cartels are using drones. "Most cartels and cartel associates still rely on commercial-off-the-shelf drones," he said. More sophisticated aircraft are emerging, however, including "larger agricultural drone devices." He added, "Cartels continue to innovate their drone designs, often focused on increasing payload sizes, improving resistance to countermeasures and boosting operational capabilities." He identified surveillance and logistics as the dominant border roles, with weaponized use more frequently documented inside Mexico. "Cartels and cartel affiliates use drones for a wide range of tactics and operations. … That includes kinetic attacks on rival factions, civilians in Mexico and local security forces." Doctor said NCITE research identified the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, or CJNG, as "a key driver of drone innovation and adoption within the Mexico cartel ecosystem," although drone use has spread among cartels and across Mexican states. FBI WARNS BATTLEFIELD-STYLE DRONE ATTACKS COULD REACH US: 'ONLY A MATTER OF TIME' A 2025 seizure in Reynosa, Tamaulipas, shows how border regions can support those programs. Mexico’s security cabinet said soldiers and state police detained a man and seized 18 drones, 151 explosive objects, two improvised explosive devices, a drone detector and three counter-drone devices. The official announcement did not identify a cartel. Doctor said the safehouse "was reported as linked to the Los Metros faction of the Gulf Cartel." Weaponized drones have also reached a Mexican border city. In October 2025, Baja California’s prosecutor said a drone dropped homemade explosive devices at an anti-kidnapping prosecutor’s office in Tijuana, damaging four vehicles but causing no injuries. Authorities described it as criminal retaliation but did not publicly identify a cartel. Doctor said Tijuana was among the exceptions to the pattern of attacks occurring farther inside Mexico. Border regions, he said, remain "critical facilitation hubs," and the risk of increased kinetic attacks there "remains credible." Mexico says it is responding with interdictions, counter-drone equipment, military operations and new criminal penalties. During last month's Águila Alta operation in the Tijuana-San Diego area, the defense ministry said Mexican forces neutralized five drones, detained one person and seized a gun, magazines and ammunition. One aircraft was initially detected in the U.S. and later neutralized in Mexico following information-sharing with Customs and Border Protection. Officials said the operation deterred criminal activity and strengthened coordination but released no before-and-after data showing whether drone traffic subsequently declined. Mexico made certain drone-related conduct a federal crime in 2024, including dropping explosives, adapting aircraft to carry weapons or drugs and surveilling public officials. CBP OFFICERS SEIZE $67 MILLION IN ILLEGAL DRUGS AT SAN DIEGO BORDER PORTS, DHS SAYS Earlier this month, Mexico deployed 500 soldiers and National Guard members, two helicopters, drones and mobile and fixed counter-drone systems in five Tamaulipas municipalities. The Navy separately reported 159 personnel, 11 vehicles and two drones under Operation Sable. In response to Fox News Digital's questions, a Department of War spokesperson said Joint Task Force-Southern Border, CBP and the Department of Homeland Security use layered monitoring and detection systems to "observe, evaluate and, if needed, engage threats." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP What remains unknown is the number of cartel-operated drones, which groups control individual flights and whether Mexico’s countermeasures are producing results. Doctor said increased counter-drone resources are important but cautioned that "it is almost certain that cartels will continue to innovate and adapt."

articles.title: US lifts sanctions on Venezuela’s top legislator
articles.summary: Jorge Rodriguez has been removed from OFAC’s sanctions list in latest US push for oil control and bilateral diplomacy.
articles.body:
The United States Department of the Treasury has lifted sanctions on the head of Venezuela’s National Assembly, Jorge Rodriguez, brother of the country’s interim President, Delcy Rodriguez.

The move by US Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) comes amid major US-Venezuela energy pacts and other talks with the Latin American country’s government.

The delisting notice was posted on the federal agency’s website on Wednesday, officially removing Jorge Rodriguez’s name from OFAC’s Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) blacklist.

The top lawmaker in the country, Jorge Rodriguez has held the position of National Assembly president since 2021. He was reappointed in January, weeks after the abduction of former President Nicolas Maduro by the US government. He served as vice president under Venezuela’s late President Hugo Chavez, among other posts.

Jorge and Delcy Rodriguez had been sanctioned under US President Donald Trump’s first administration due to their ministerial roles under Maduro, who now faces several federal charges, including a sweeping superseding indictment adding torture to his other alleged crimes.

In 2018, the State Department said that Jorge Rodriguez was given prominent government positions by Maduro “to help him maintain power and solidify his authoritarian rule”.

A source familiar with the matter told Al Jazeera that the decision to lift sanctions on Jorge Rodriguez is part of Washington’s wider diplomatic recognition of the interim Venezuelan government, and Trump’s three-phase plan for Venezuela’s stabilisation and political transition.

During a press briefing at the US State Department on Friday, Secretary of State Marco Rubio told reporters that the next round of negotiations on Venezuela’s future was scheduled to begin on Wednesday. He also urged all Venezuelan opposition factions to join US-backed political talks with the interim president.

Earlier this year, the US Treasury dropped sanctions against Delcy Rodriguez and later lifted the restrictions on Venezuela’s central bank and its state-owned national airline, signalling Washington’s pivot from economic warfare to backroom bargaining . She has largely complied with Trump’s demands for Caracas to open up its energy industry to American companies.

As interim president, Delcy Rodriguez has promised to hold elections – including in her recent remarks at the United Nations General Assembly – but no firm date has been set. Opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner Maria Corina Machado has demanded they take place by July.

Jorge Rodriguez has shepherded several major reforms through the ruling party-controlled legislature since his sister took power, including a law that facilitated the entry of more foreign oil companies, a similar law for the mining sector and an effort to allow private investment for the country’s battered power grid.

Since Maduro’s ouster, Caracas and Washington have cut a deal giving the US access to 17 Venezuelan oil fields, while international energy firms have separately committed to expanding projects in the Latin American country. In August, Trump announced a plan to secure direct US access to a large share of Venezuela’s vast oil to refill the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve.

articles.title: Spanish NGO halts Mediterranean rescue operations, citing fuel prices
articles.summary: SMH says it can no longer afford search-and-rescue work in one of the world’s most dangerous migration routes.
articles.body:
A Spanish charity has postponed its next migrant rescue mission in the Central Mediterranean until next year due to rising fuel costs, underscoring the humanitarian impact of rising energy prices.

Salvamento Maritimo Humanitario (Humanitarian Maritime Rescue, or SMH) said on Wednesday that the doubling of fuel prices forced it to shift its activities to waters around Valencia, southeastern Spain.

The group, which operates a fishing vessel converted into a rescue ship, also launched a crowdfunding campaign to cover the extra costs.

The Central Mediterranean crossing from North Africa to Italy is one of the world’s most dangerous migration routes.

Many of those attempt the crossing on overcrowded, unsuitable boats from Libya’s coast, which has been a main transit point for migrants fleeing war and poverty in Africa and the Middle East.

A report released by the International Office for Migration said migrant sea crossings have dropped sharply since January this year.

The agency said about 60,000 migrants and refugees reached Europe by boat so far in 2026, down 39 percent from roughly 98,000 over the same period last year.

Despite the drop, at least 2,292 died or went missing attempting the crossing this year.

Spanish NGO Open Arms has said it scaled back its Central Mediterranean missions in recent years, also due to rising fuel costs as well as Italy’s policy of assigning rescue vessels ports in Northern Italy.

NGO ships from Spain typically sail for two to three days to reach their operating area, increasing costs and reducing time available for search-and-rescue work.

The Italian prime minister’s right-wing, anti-immigration government says humanitarian rescue attempts encourage migrants to make the crossing.

articles.title: Starlink: Musk says US government may be behind slowdown of Ukraine drone speeds
articles.summary: Ukraine says Starlink access has improved but it is still facing speed limits which are disrupting its battlefield "missions".
articles.body:
Elon Musk has suggested that the US government may be behind restrictions on the speed at which some of Ukraine's weapons can travel and stay connected to SpaceX's Starlink internet network.

Starlink is a vital tool allowing Kyiv to guide drones to Russian targets and also protect its own skies, but on Tuesday night Ukraine said unexpected new speed limits were disrupting its battlefield missions.

An adviser to President Volodymyr Zelensky said he believed the restrictions were not a coincidence and were related to the latest strains between Kyiv and Washington.

Musk said that Starshield, the military-grade sister service to Starlink, is controlled by the US government, and "any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately [the US president]".

Musk - writing on X - had been responding to pleas from Ukrainian officials to restore connectivity, including from Zelensky who told UK media: "I hope that it's a mistake, maybe [a] huge technical problem. I don't know, but we are asking to... switch [it] on."

Starlink, which is owned by Musk's SpaceX, restricted speed limits on Tuesday night to 100mph (160km/h), meaning any weapons that travelled faster than that lost connectivity to the network.

It had been partially restored by Wednesday evening, Ukraine's former defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov said.

"Removing Starshield's speed limit entirely is now critical for Ukraine's defense," he wrote on X, thanking Elon Musk and asking for his "continued support".

About an hour later, Musk replied to that post, defending his company's involvement.

"Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS," he wrote.

Musk added that Starlink is for "civilian or defensive activities and cannot be used for offensive military action, as doing so would be inappropriate for a commercial company".

While both companies are owned by Musk's SpaceX, Starlink is a civilian service that uses satellites in low Earth orbit to provide internet access, particularly in remote areas, while Starshield is designed for government and military use.

The restrictions on Tuesday night came as Russia launched deadly attacks against Ukraine that killed several people in Kyiv, officials said, and hit communications and energy facilities used by Ukraine's military.

Zelensky said it was "one of the largest attacks" from Russia, and while "a significant part of the drones were shot down" there were "also hits".

At least 600,000 people across Ukraine were left without electricity, and residents said they received no warning of incoming drones before they hit.

"It is clear that this action cannot be a coincidence and is related to the current political situation," Zelensky's adviser Serhiy Beskrestnov wrote on Telegram on Wednesday morning.

US President Donald Trump has grown increasingly frustrated towards Ukraine as it continues to strike Russian energy facilities.

Zelensky has said that the US threatened to restrict intelligence sharing if he did not sign up to Trump's energy ceasefire, but on Tuesday, Trump denied this.

Speaking during a visit to London on Wednesday, Zelensky agreed that he had felt betrayed after the US made a deal with Russia to import 300,000 tonnes of its diesel.

"Really yes... but it's a little bit more complicated than just my emotions or my feelings," Zelensky said, when asked by UK journalist Piers Morgan if he felt betrayed.

During his one-day visit , Zelensky was greeted with a hug by UK PM Andy Burnham at Downing Street and held an audience with King Charles.

Ahead of the president's arrival, No 10 announced it would speed up delivery of lightweight multirole missiles to Ukraine, which have been used to bring down Russian drones.

"We are behind you and that will not change," Burnham told Zelensky.

articles.body: Only the right eyes can spot a hidden treasure. This particular session was held at Seacourt Hall in Botley, Oxfordshire.£5 ring turned out to be a real diamond ringGemologist Asha Nayak examined the jewellery and found that the ring was set in 18-carat gold. The company has not said whether the owner accepted an offer for the ring or kept it. That detail remains unknown.What is clear is the arithmetic: a £5 purchase, one expert’s close inspection, and an estimate roughly 3,000 times the price paid! While many people walked past that sparkly ring, this woman noticed it. Although she did not know its true value at the time, her instincts told her it was worth the £5.
